overall_summary: Data clearly shows that husband-wife relationship dynamics and domestic life topics (Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya, Wife Emotional Video) dramatically outperform general sad poetry, single-line shayari, or generic sibling videos. Repeatable success stems from exploring complex marital realities and unspoken household grievances.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,672 views) garnered the highest views and engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on husband-wife dynamics, post-marriage emotional shifts, and domestic relationship truths.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framed as direct psychological or emotional questions targeted at couples drive significantly higher clicks.
winning_patterns.action: Use direct, probing questions addressing common marital struggles in the title and opening hook.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received only 14 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or abstract lines; focus instead on grounded, everyday domestic observations.

weak_patterns.evidence: General sibling videos like 'बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है' stalled around 19 to 136 views compared to parental or spousal content.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standalone sibling content unless tied to a specific household conflict or marital perspective.

next_video.hook_style: Direct observational statement about changing behavior after a few years of marriage
next_video.concept: A realization about how midnight chats between a married couple eventually turn into silent scrolling on separate phones in the same bed.
next_video.opening_direction: Start with a simple visual of two tea cups growing cold on a table while a couple sits silently side-by-side.
next_video.twist_direction: The emotional twist reveals that they aren't fighting; they just ran out of things to say to each other, missing the person they used to be before life took over.
next_video.reason: Capitalizes on the proven high-performing husband-wife relationship theme, leveraging a relatable domestic routine that hits home for adult viewers.

experiment: Testing if shifting the husband-wife narrative from overt conflict ('Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya') to silent emotional distance improves retention and comment interaction.
